# Awesome Reinforcement Learning Environments [![Awesome](https://awesome.re/badge.svg)](https://awesome.re)

A curated list of awesome environments and training frameworks for Reinforcement Learning, organized by domain.

---

## 🖥️ Computer Use
- [BrowserGym](https://github.com/openai/browsergym) – Benchmark for RL agents interacting with web browsers.  
- [MiniWoB++](https://github.com/stanfordnlp/miniwob-plusplus) – Web-based GUI interaction tasks for RL research.  
- [WebShop](https://github.com/princeton-nlp/WebShop) – Simulated e-commerce environment for RL agents acting as web shoppers.  

## 💻 Code
- [CodeRL (paper)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.01780) – Safe code generation via RL in programming tasks.  
- [PyCoder Environment](https://github.com/ysymyth/pycoder) – RL environment for synthesizing Python code.  
- [APPS Benchmark](https://github.com/hendrycks/apps) – Programming problem RL benchmark for code-generating agents.  

## 🎮 Games
- [Arcade Learning Environment](https://github.com/Farama-Foundation/Arcade-Learning-Environment) – Atari 2600 classics for RL.  
- [Procgen](https://github.com/openai/procgen) – Procedurally generated 2D games to test generalization in RL.  
- [ViZDoom](https://github.com/mwydmuch/ViZDoom) – Doom-based first-person navigation and combat environment.  
- [DeepMind Lab](https://github.com/google-deepmind/lab) – 3D game-like environment for navigation and puzzles.  
- [Google Research Football](https://github.com/google-research/football) – Multi-agent soccer RL environment.  

## 🤖 Robotics
- [Isaac Gym](https://github.com/NVIDIA-Omniverse/IsaacGymEnvs) – GPU-accelerated physics for robot control.  
- [DeepMind Control Suite](https://github.com/google-deepmind/dm_control) – MuJoCo-powered continuous control suite.  
- [PyBullet Gym](https://github.com/benelot/pybullet-gym) – Bullet-based analogs of MuJoCo environments.  
- [Meta-World](https://github.com/Farama-Foundation/Metaworld) – 50 Sawyer manipulation tasks for multi-task/meta RL.  
- [Brax](https://github.com/google/brax) – JAX-based fast physics engine with RL tasks.

## 🌍 Real World
- [CARLA](https://github.com/carla-simulator/carla) – High-fidelity autonomous driving simulator.  
- [HighwayEnv](https://github.com/Farama-Foundation/HighwayEnv) – Driving decision-making environments (merging, parking, etc.).  
- [CityLearn](https://github.com/intelligent-environments-lab/CityLearn) – Multi-building energy management RL environment.  
- [Grid2Op](https://github.com/Grid2op/grid2op) – Power grid operations simulation for RL in reliability control.  
- [Habitat Lab](https://github.com/facebookresearch/habitat-lab) – Photorealistic indoor navigation for embodied agents.  
- [FinRL](https://github.com/AI4Finance-Foundation/FinRL) – Trading and portfolio management RL library.  

## 🛡️ SafeRL (Safety-Focused Environments)
- [Assistive-Gym](https://github.com/Farama-Foundation/assistive-gym) – Assistive robotics tasks (feeding, dressing) with human models and multiple robots.  
- [DeepMind AI Safety Gridworlds](https://github.com/deepmind/ai-safety-gridworlds) – Suite of environments illustrating safety properties of RL agents.  
- [Safety Gym](https://github.com/openai/safety-gym) – Mujoco-based environments designed for safe exploration research.  
- [Safe-Control-Gym](https://github.com/utiasDSL/safe-control-gym) – CartPole and Quadrotor tasks with safety-aware control.  
- [Safety-Gymnasium (paper)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.12567) – A unified SafeRL benchmark with single/multi-agent safety-critical tasks and SafePO algorithm suite.  
- [SafeLife (paper)](https://arxiv.org/abs/1912.01217) – Procedurally generated tasks to study safe behaviors and side-effects in RL.  

## ⚙️ RL Training & Verifiers
- [prime-RL](https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-rl) – Decentralized RL training at scale with modular environment support and verifiers.  
- [Verifiers](https://github.com/delta-hq/fc-verifiers) – Toolkit for constructing RL environments and training LLMs with verifiers (supports async GRPO and Prime-RL).  
- [TinyV](https://github.com/uw-nsl/TinyV) – LLM-based verifier that reduces false negatives in RL reward signals.  
- [TTRL (Test-Time Reinforcement Learning)](https://github.com/PRIME-RL/TTRL) – Online RL method for self-supervision on unlabeled test data.  
- [RL Tango](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.15034) – Method that co-trains generator and verifier LLMs via RL for more robust reasoning.
